entities.name: GcpE/IspG
observations: The 355-residue query is an exact full-length sequence match to curated UniProt Q8RA30, a 4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl diphosphate synthase (flavodoxin).
Pfam domains GcpE (PF04551.20; residues 8–247) and GcpE_C (PF26540.1; residues 262–350) support the GcpE/IspG family assignment.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular mass approximately 39.0 kDa and theoretical pI 8.88.

entities.name: MEcPP to HMBPP
observations: The reductive transformation uses reduced flavodoxin or ferredoxin as the electron donor and produces oxidized electron carrier; water and protons participate in the balanced reaction representation.
The reaction is EC 1.17.7.3 and is represented by Rhea RHEA:43604; alternate direction records include RHEA:10622 and RHEA:10623.

entities.name: MEP isoprenoid pathway
observations: GcpE/IspG catalyzes step 5 of 6 in the methylerythritol 4-phosphate (MEP/DOXP) pathway for synthesis of the universal isoprenoid precursors IPP and DMAPP.
